This means we are looking for skilled Enercon Wind Turbine Technicians who are passionate about keeping things spinning smoothly. If you’ve got a knack for troubleshooting and love the challenge of working with Enercon turbines, this might be the perfect role for you! You will also have the opportunity to learn new skills and work with other technologies as our portfolio grows. This role may take you on the road across Scotland, giving you the chance to explore its beautiful sights and meet new people along the way. You’ll mentor and train others, helping new technicians hit the ground running on-site while providing hands-on support whenever needed. Maintenance & Troubleshooting You’ll be the key to keeping our Enercon turbines in top shape. From scheduled maintenance to those unexpected call-outs, you’ll tackle it all. Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic issues will be your bread and butter, as will conducting thorough inspections and replacing components as needed. With each visit, you’ll log every detail keeping service reports and turbine performance records up to date is just as important as turning those wrenches. Safety always comes first, and you’ll ensure every task meets industry standards. Keeping Our Customers In The Loop You’ll be the point of contact for our customers on-site, keeping them informed and reassured throughout every step of the maintenance process. Your updates help us build trust while keeping the turbines turning. Safety & Quality: Your North Star You’ll stick to safety protocols, no concessions allowed, spotting potential hazards and addressing them before they become an issue. You’ll also make sure that every component of the wind turbine big or small meets our high standards for quality and reliability. It’s up to you to ensure the safe and efficient operation of both electrical and mechanical components. Catch The Breeze Of Improvement You won’t just maintain our fleet you’ll help us make it better. Working with engineering and operational teams, you’ll look for ways to boost turbine performance and efficiency. Using error and gap analysis, response times, and operational data, you’ll keep things running as smoothly as a perfect gust of wind. Occasionally, you’ll also work with the control room, remotely monitoring turbines all over the world because our reach goes far beyond the horizon. What You’ll Need In Your Toolkit Experience: 3+ years working with Enercon turbines or similar models; you can either be a CT or an AT Expertise: Strong knowledge of electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. Bring a positive, can-do attitude to work every day A natural problem-solver with a keen eye for detail who takes pride in delivering quality services Collaborative and flexible, yet confident in taking ownership and working independently. What’s in it for you? At Full Circle, we don’t just offer a competitive pay and benefits package (though you’ll get that too, including pension contributions, health and life insurance, an electric car scheme, holiday purchase options, gym discounts, and access to our employee support program). More importantly, you’ll have the chance to shape your career in a way that works for you. Whether that means learning new technologies on our wind farm sites, stepping into a remote support role, or growing into a leadership position, we’ll support you in finding the path that fits your skills and ambitions. If you’re ready to join us in harnessing the power of the wind and driving forward the future of clean energy, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today, and let’s keep the world turning one turbine at a time! 🌎💨 About Full Circle At Full Circle, we’ve been in the wind turbine game for over two decades, and now, we’re ready to spread our wings and soar as an independent entity, supporting various wind turbine brands. We’re here to dish out top-tier maintenance support to everyone in need, regardless of the turbine brand or whether you’ve got one or a hundred turbines in your backyard. Expect us to swoop in with agile, honest, and lightning-fast support. From routine maintenance to blade inspections, repairs, 24/7 remote monitoring, and even those must-do statutory inspections – we’ve got your back! Basically, everything to keep those turbines dancing in the wind. Our Secret Sauce: Expertise, Resources, and a Personal Touch! We’re renowned for our wizard-like expertise, abundant resources, and a friendly, personalised approach that ensures you squeeze every last whirl out of those turbines. Our HQ: Where Magic Happens! Our headquarters are nestled in the lively city of Amersfoort, Netherlands. But hey, our squad is scattered all across Europe, maintaining wind turbines across the globe. Meet Our Funky, Spirited Team. We’re not just a team; we’re a bubbling cauldron of enthusiasm and youthfulness, growing alongside our company. That makes our work environment an absolute blast, overflowing with energy and collaboration! We’re open, direct, and as honest as a clear blue sky, reflecting the diverse world we live in! Hey, You! Still Here? Join the Fun! If you’re still hanging in there and thinking, “This sounds like my kind of jam,” hit that apply button. We’re itching to meet folks who match our vibe and skills. Let’s make some wind turbine magic together! Join us at Full Circle. If you’re keen on renewable energy and thrive in a dynamic environment, we want you on our team! Apply Now and Let’s Rock the Wind Turbine World Together! Note To 3rd Parties Here at Full Circle, we are very lucky to be very successful at recruiting all our new employees ourselves. Something we are very proud of. Despite our kind requests to all of you not to reach out for support in this area, our HR team, hiring managers and our front office are overwhelmed with contact requests, telephone calls, email requests and other attempts to get in touch. We know you guys are out there; we understand that this cold acquisition is part of your job, but we strongly request that you respect our time and not reach out. We want to use all the time we have to make the world a greener place! If we ever need support, we’ll work with our preferred suppliers (and no, we are not looking for new ones;-)) We appreciate your understanding in this, and we wish you the best of luck in finding your next client.

review_candidates.description: Company overview: MN8 Energy is one of the largest independent solar energy and energy storage owner-operators in the U.S., serving enterprise customers with clean energy and complementary solutions, such as battery storage and EV Charging, to enable an electrified, decarbonized world. Originally founded inside of Goldman Sachs in 2017, our fleet has grown to nearly 3-gigawatts of solar, including 850 projects across 27 states, and over 270 megawatts of battery storage projects, with each project tailored to achieve the bold decarbonization targets and goals of our more than 200 blue-chip customers. MN8 is headquartered in New York with offices in Dallas, Boca Raton, Florida and Madrid. For more information: mn8energy.com. Position overview: MN8 Energy is seeking a Manager / Senior Manager to play a leadership role in our entry into the large-scale data center and industrial load campus market. This is a leadership position responsible for transforming MN8’s existing land and interconnection assets into "ready-to-build" campuses for hyperscalers and data center developers. This role serves as the owner of the Powered Land product, bridging power and data center development disciplines, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and directing the technical workstreams necessary to deliver development-ready sites. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of developing data center sites, securing high-voltage interconnections, and negotiating complex commercial agreements from the perspective of a hyperscaler, developer, or major utility. As the Sr/Manager, Large Load Development, you will: 1. Strategic Pipeline Development Portfolio Evaluation: Review and screen MN8’s existing operating portfolio / development pipeline to identify sites with high potential for "Powered Land” development Greenfield Prospecting: Direct the identification and acquisition of new land positions specifically targeted for large-scale load campuses and digital infrastructure. 2. Commercial Leadership & Monetization Customer Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer universe – including hyperscalers, colocation providers, neoclouds, PE / infra platforms, etc. Deal Structuring: Lead negotiations for site sales, build-to-suit leases, or joint venture structures that maximize value for MN8. Productization: Package MN8’s powered-land sites into a clear, sellable product—defining readiness milestones, packaging, and the commercial logic a customer can underwrite and buy. 3. Interconnection & Infrastructure Management Grid Strategy: Work with the engineering and interconnection teams to accelerate interconnection applications, EPC coordination, substation design, and transmission-level power delivery. Utility Relations: Leverage existing utility relationships to navigate complex queue processes, load applications, and advance load-study milestones for future campuses. Site Readiness & Permitting: Drive site development strategies that enable successful client deployments, ensuring critical infrastructure and regulatory requirements are secured in alignment with customer schedules and growth objectives. Act as a key liaison among utilities, government agencies, and stakeholders to accelerate project readiness and reduce execution risk. 4. Cross-Functional Execution Collaborate with the Strategy & Investment, Development, Regulatory, Legal, and other teams of ensure projects are de-risked and meet the internal hurdles for capital deployment. Advise on the integration of onsite energy storage and "behind-the-meter" solar solutions to enhance the overall value of the campuses. Our Ideal candidate will have: Experience: 4–8 years in energy development (preference to large load vs. generation), real estate, or digital infrastructure. Track Record: Direct involvement in the successful development of data center, power, or large-load projects—hands-on project work matters more than a specific MW threshold. Expertise: Deep understanding of the data center "Power Stack": from transmission-level interconnects and substation engineering to the real estate nuances of site control and permitting. Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to negotiate Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), load interconnection agreements, Master Services Agreements (MSAs), and other complex power / land transactions. Network: An existing "Rolodex" of contacts within major utilities, the power & real estate arms of major hyperscalers (AWS, Google, Meta, Microsoft), new pure play AI platforms. Preferred: Behind-the-meter (BTM) development experience, particularly in gas/other thermal generation. Understanding of microgrid design, development, and operations is also a large plus. How We Set You Up For Success: At MN8, we know our most valuable resource is our people. That’s why we offer the following benefits. By investing in you, we know we are investing in the clean energy of tomorrow. Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance beginning the 1st of the month following your date of hire Paid Time Off Paid holidays and floating holidays 401(k) with competitive employer match Parental leave MN8 Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and fully subscribes to the principles of Equal Employment Opportunity to ensure that all applicants and employees are considered for hire, promotion, and job status without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital or familial status.
